item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 20/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring very hot weather to Guangdong in the next few days. The area of low pressure now over the seas east of the Philippines is expected to develop into a tropical cyclone and intensify gradually. It will move towards the vicinity of east of Luzon in the next few days. It is more likely that it will enter the northern part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week, bringing unsettled weather to the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. However, the movement of the system remains uncertain. It may move towards the vicinity of Taiwan instead.
